# Velair 1.6.0-beta.1

Velair 1.6.0-beta.1 expands climate range support, makes Room Assist safer and
more observable, preserves schedules across weekdays, and improves delivery to
temporarily unavailable climate controllers.

## ✨ Added

- Added native lower and upper temperature targets for compatible `heat_cool`
  climates across schedules, Profiles, Modes, templates, services, Boost,
  Adaptive Preconditioning, Room Assist, the timeline, and Overview.
- Profile schedules can now save the current day as a reusable template or
  clone it to other compatible managed climates from the Profile editor.

## 🔄 Changed

- Room Assist now applies signed corrections in both directions, protects
  fixed heating and cooling schedules from internal-sensor drift, and moves
  native `heat_cool` ranges as complete width-preserving bands.
- Adaptive Preconditioning now starts a complete `heat_cool` range early using
  the relevant heating or cooling boundary while preserving existing learning
  history.
- Portable imports and exports now use model version 6 so native temperature
  ranges remain intact between installations.

## 🚀 Improved

- Scheduler-owned climate targets now use bounded retries after explicit Home
  Assistant service failures and re-resolve the current intent when a managed
  climate becomes available again, without polling or replaying stale targets.
- Room Assist now shows scheduled-target protection, signed corrections,
  complete range movement, and physical thermostat limits in its live status.
  The Room Assist tab now distinguishes Not configured, Disabled, Idle, Ready,
  Assisting, Holding, Blocked, and Unavailable, while Overview summarizes active
  control as Active, Holding, or Scheduled protection. Physical limits also
  create one recoverable Home Assistant notification.
- Native range inputs, Profile editing actions, inherited timeline periods,
  mobile graphs, and contextual help have been refined for phone and tablet
  layouts.

## 🛠️ Fixed

- Fixed the latest weekly block not remaining active across midnight or empty
  weekdays, including startup and Profile or Mode activation.
- Fixed delayed Room Assist callbacks reusing a previous schedule block and
  internal climate readings walking protected heating, cooling, or range
  targets in the wrong direction.
- Fixed invalid or superseded climate operations changing Room Assist or
  Adaptive Preconditioning runtime state after their intent was no longer
  current.
- Fixed Comfort and Room Assist help text extending beyond the screen on
  mobile.

## 🧭 Notes

- This is a beta release intended for real-world testing before Velair 1.6.0.
  Feedback on native `heat_cool`, Room Assist, Adaptive Preconditioning, weekly
  continuity, and temporarily unavailable controllers is especially useful.
- Room Assist controls Home Assistant targets but cannot override device
  firmware hysteresis, compressor protection, or minimum run times. Use an
  `Off` block when an explicit shutdown is required.
- Read the versioned [Room Assist guide](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/blob/v1.6.0-beta.1/docs/user/room-assist.md)
  for the live-state meanings and numerical examples comparing the previous
  one-direction behavior with signed inversion, scheduled protection, native
  `heat_cool` range movement, and physical target limits.
- Update through HACS when possible, restart Home Assistant, and refresh the
  browser or companion app after installing the beta.
